description: This file defines the AthenaClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used to interact with the Amazon Athena service. It includes method annotations for various API calls supported by the client.

classes.name: AthenaClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Athena, extending the generic AwsClient class with Athena-specific methods.

methods.name: batchGetNamedQuery
methods.description: Executes the batchGetNamedQuery API call to retrieve multiple named query details.

methods.name: batchGetNamedQueryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes the batchGetNamedQuery API call.

methods.name: createCapacityReservation
methods.description: Creates a new capacity reservation for Athena queries.
